research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Kinter is engaged in research and development of retail display hardware, focusing on innovations such as a label protection rail with a universal slot pattern. This device features a mounting portion for attachment to shelving units, a base portion, and a shield portion designed to extend in front of the shelf edge, enhancing protection and functionality for retail shelving systems. These activities highlight Kinter’s focus on improving retail display hardware solutions.

about_short_description.short_description: kinder is a manufacturing and distributing retail display hardware.

product.name: Retail Display Hardware
product.description: A broad range of hardware products designed for retail display applications, including label solutions, display hooks, product merchandising, sign and literature holders, and display construction components.

product.name: Custom Design & Capabilities
product.description: In-house services offering custom design, prototyping, and manufacturing solutions including engineering support, 3-D printing, injection molding, extrusion, and metal/plastic fabrication for retail display hardware.

product.name: K-Stick® Ladderless Sign Hanging System
product.description: A hardware system designed for hanging signs without the use of ladders, facilitating safer and more efficient sign installation in retail environments.

product.name: Label Solutions
product.description: Hardware components designed to support the display and organization of product labels in retail settings.

product.name: Display Hooks
product.description: Hardware hooks used to hang and display products on retail fixtures, enhancing product accessibility and visibility.

product.name: Product Merchandising Hardware
product.description: Components used to arrange and present products effectively on retail displays to optimize shopper engagement and product organization.
